# THE APPROACH TO CELLULITIS

In addition to antimicrobial therapy, several non-pharmacological treatments improve the outcome of cellulitis.Elevation and immobilization of the affected limb reduces swelling. Heat reduces discomfort.
Prevent tinea pedis infection by keeping feet clean and dry. In patients with peripheral edema, good skin hygiene and support stockings reduce the incidence of recurrent infection.
In many cases of cellulitis, the affected area is usually not well-differeniated from unaffected areas of the skin. [Erysipelas](erysipelas) is a special case with typically a well-defined border and raised, orange-peel appearance.
